intelligence.essence: The Skills page does not need ten questions — it needs to be done right so the message gets across: this is what I have to offer, this is my ability, my skills, my service, my offering to the world. It follows the anatomy of a résumé: the top is who you are — name, phone number, and the rest — then the statement: this is what I'm looking for, and this is what I have to offer. On the Skills page the headline comes first: "ultimately this is what I have to offer and this is what I'm looking to do for you." Then the experiences. A business says simply "here's my services." A person says "this is what I'm good at" — sports, technology, AI, dance, whatever it is. And it is not necessarily selling: "connect with me, I'm good at XYZ."
